status: Storyboard proposal for review; production has not started
title: One idea. Twenty worlds.
format: 60 seconds, 1920x1080, 60 fps, Motion Studio, no voiceover
music: The Golden Hour Rise, supplied local recording. Ivan Is Loading excluded. Exact accents/source trim to be measured during an animatic; scene times are proposed edit slots.

referenceIntent.adapt: Conceptual dimensional progression; shape registration while material and camera change.
Registered editorial cuts, actual artwork, selective transformation of existing glyphs and varied exposure lengths.
Overlapping container/content changes, causal interaction, stable visual anchors.

scenes.picture: Black field; a hairline frame catches a warm orange glint. The camera rushes into its corner; ONE IDEA appears, then 20 WORLDS opens across the screen.
scenes.handoff: The orange punctuation mark breaks into a directional particle trail.
scenes.sound: Near-silent opening gesture, then the chosen track enters on the first main reveal.

scenes.picture: Thousands of warm points sweep around a negative-space camera aperture. The camera passes through the aperture as the trail curls toward one bright point.
scenes.handoff: Particles gather into one continuous glossy drop without losing their travel direction.
scenes.sound: A rising air sweep with one tight gathering accent.

scenes.picture: A macro orange ink ribbon stretches, joins and opens into a flexible rectangular frame. Surface tension and shifting reflections sell liquid rather than an elastic outline.
scenes.handoff: The ribbon spreads flat; its rounded edges snap into the primary-shape poster grid.
scenes.sound: Liquid movement and one soft contact accent; leave the sustained phrase to the music.

scenes.picture: Cream paper, cobalt circle, vermilion square and yellow triangle. Shapes rotate on a strict grid, trade positions, and stack into a deliberately composed poster.
scenes.handoff: The circle rolls forward and gains thickness; the paper plane tips into a tactile tabletop.
scenes.sound: Three dry, pitched contacts on the shape landings.

scenes.picture: The shapes become a miniature clay movie camera. Its lens squashes as the orange signal lands, then rebounds; thumbprint texture, soft shadows and a short orbit reveal its weight.
scenes.handoff: A travelling light scans across the clay camera, replacing its surface with precise construction lines at the same silhouette.
scenes.sound: Muted clay contact and a small mechanical settle.

scenes.picture: Deep blue drafting surface. The same movie camera separates into body, lens and film-gate layers. Dimension arrows and construction strokes arrive in the order parts separate.
scenes.handoff: Drafting lines rise off the page into a spatial mesh; the camera follows the orange lens centre.
scenes.sound: Drafting strokes and two restrained part-release ticks.

scenes.picture: The exploded camera reassembles as a clean spatial mesh. A quarter orbit reveals structure; push through the film gate into a field of perspective lines.
scenes.handoff: Those perspective lines become the streets and blocks of a miniature studio district.
scenes.sound: Fine mechanical ticks, then a short pass-through sweep.

scenes.picture: An authored miniature film studio unfolds: soundstage, editing room, lighting towers and a billboard. The orange signal travels through the set; windows and lights respond as it passes.
scenes.handoff: The camera approaches the billboard until it fills the frame, then reveals its surface as a glass player containing the same studio.
scenes.sound: Small tactile steps and two light-on accents.

scenes.picture: The isometric world plays inside frosted panes. A cursor scrubs the player; progress and scene state update together. Foreground glass occludes moving colour behind it.
scenes.handoff: The panes separate in depth; their refractions become spectral light sheets around the miniature world.
scenes.sound: One glass contact and a concise scrub gesture.

scenes.picture: The studio becomes a translucent iridescent projection. Thin cyan, rose and violet light sheets sweep through its geometry while the orange signal stays solid.
scenes.handoff: A spectral sheet passes close to camera and expands into a flowing colour field.
scenes.sound: A restrained shimmer attached to the light-sheet pass.

scenes.picture: Saffron, rose and cobalt fields flow like stretched fabric. Large italic FEEL SOMETHING sits in a calm pocket as the colour currents continue around it.
scenes.handoff: The flowing curves straighten into a symmetrical fan; warm highlights settle into gold lines.
scenes.sound: Music carries the breath; one soft fold accent at the exit.

scenes.picture: Matte black with gold stepped arches and a precise sunburst fan. The orange signal climbs a centre line, opening a geometric cinema marquee.
scenes.handoff: Camera closes on the fan's gold ink; its surface separates into printed dots.
scenes.sound: A subtle metallic lock when the fan reaches symmetry.

scenes.picture: An oversized movie-camera cutout sits within the arch on cream paper. Cyan/magenta registration offsets slide into place; real dot screens grow visibly across the image.
scenes.handoff: The printed page folds along a diagonal; its crop becomes the first panel of a comic strip.
scenes.sound: A dry print registration click and short paper fold.

scenes.picture: Three inked panels show anticipation, a camera shutter snap, then an orange projectile bursting through the panel gutter. Heavy outlines, perspective speed lines and a brief SNAP balloon.
scenes.handoff: The broken panel border lands as a thick black frame around the next poster; preserve the projectile's trajectory.
scenes.sound: Shutter snap followed by one panel-break impact.

scenes.picture: A cobalt poster slams onto cream with a thick black border and hard offset shadow. MAKE / YOUR / MARK stacks with different impact timings; the orange signal knocks a corner loose.
scenes.handoff: The offset blocks resolve onto a coarse pixel grid from the impact point outward.
scenes.sound: Two weighty contacts with a short gap between them.

scenes.picture: A side-scrolling pixel soundstage uses original sprites, stepped motion and crisp grid alignment. The orange token jumps a gap and lights four letter blocks spelling MOVE.
scenes.handoff: The pixel image pulls back into the screen of a vintage television.
scenes.sound: A short original pickup run, kept beneath the supplied music.

scenes.picture: The television shows the same pixel scene through scanlines, soft chroma bleed and a controlled tracking roll. A chrome MOVE title briefly catches the tube's light.
scenes.handoff: One tracking seam expands across the screen; its noise resolves into rows of characters.
scenes.sound: A brief tape-start/tracking texture, cut cleanly before the next scene.

scenes.picture: Monospace characters draw the camera silhouette row by row. One orange @ moves through the contour, waking adjacent characters; the rest of the frame stays disciplined.
scenes.handoff: Character cells gain physical thickness and horizontal hinges.
scenes.sound: A short grouped key sequence, not a click for every glyph.

scenes.picture: A physical departure-board mechanism cycles into 20 / STYLES. Each flap has a hinge, changing face and contact shadow; columns settle with a controlled stagger.
scenes.handoff: The horizontal seams extend beyond the tiles and bend into continuous luminous tubes.
scenes.sound: Grouped flap clatter that decelerates as the final word lands.

scenes.picture: Orange and cool-white tubes draw MAKE IT MOVE in darkness. Glow blooms on the surrounding surface; the orange signal travels along the tube before its final junction closes.
scenes.handoff: Camera passes the lit tube so close it becomes a full-frame stroke, then a solid typographic stem.
scenes.sound: A brief electric rise and a small junction-lock accent.

scenes.picture: MAKE. / IT. / MATTER. takes over the whole screen. Compressed type stretches, slices and snaps on three distinct accents, then gives the final word a readable landing.
scenes.handoff: The final period becomes the original orange signal; the letters open into a twenty-window recap.
scenes.sound: Three clean accents; let the last one ring into the ending.

scenes.picture: Twenty small windows briefly recall the actual scenes. Their edges fold into one aperture mark. At 57s MOTION STUDIO lands; Make every frame matter follows. The signal settles into its starting corner.
scenes.handoff: Resolve the musical phrase and hold the final identity through 60s with a small light/material settle.
scenes.sound: One signature lock and a preserved musical tail; no abrupt cut.
